issue_request: FHIR-18544 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Parameters change request from STU3 asking to replace the poor Parameters example with a realistic example, or at least one showing nested parameters, values, data types, search qualifiers, and resource content.
initial_application: Jira records Grahame Grieve's comment 'git c2efb65141'. Commit c2efb651417aa2e82c36015d00cd2d538c9a4b24 replaced the old start/end/Binary sample in source/parameters/parameters-example.xml with a richer example containing a boolean value, nested parameter parts, and a Patient resource, and added source/parameters/parameters-examples-header.xml text that points readers to real operation Parameters examples.
additional_context: Parameters is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini, and source/parameters/list-Parameters-examples.xml still publishes source/parameters/parameters-example.xml as Parameters/example. Later history only added an example id needed by the example listing and refreshed operation-example links. Jira neighborhood, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision for this issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Parameters example and examples header preserve the applied FHIR-18544 fix, and replacing the example again or adding redundant prose would not correct a current spec defect.
